screens.prompt:
Create the mobile onboarding screen for 'Hearth', a calm smart home control mobile app in DARK mode.
Viewport: 390x844px mobile viewport.
Color palette:
- Background: charcoal near-black #1A1A1A
- Cards: #2A2A2A
- Controls: #333333
- Off-white ink text: #F5F2EE
- Muted grey subtext: #8C8782
- Vivid orange accent: #F2762E
Typography: Outfit geometric sans font, clean, modern, high contrast. No gradients on elements (except smooth fade on the hero image to charcoal background), no emoji, thin rounded line icons (lucide or heroicons style SVGs).

Layout composition:
1. Top 65% of the screen: Full-bleed image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_3}} featuring the warm cozy living room interior at dusk with ambient glow lamps. At the top, include a minimal status bar and subtle brand mark 'hearth' or skip button if appropriate. The image smoothly fades with a gradient mask or dark gradient overlay into the solid charcoal page background (#1A1A1A) so the transition to the bottom content is seamless and organic.
2. Content section (bottom 35%):
- Stepper indicators: 3 small pagination dots; the first one is an active vivid orange pill (#F2762E, elongated rounded pill), followed by two inactive small subtle muted grey dots (#444444 or #333333).
- Headline: Big off-white (#F5F2EE) 2-line headline in bold Outfit:
'Your home,'
'on one tap'
- Subtitle: Clean muted subtext (#8C8782):
'Lights, climate and energy, all in one calm app.'
- Bottom Action Slider Button: A full-width rounded pill slider container (bg #2A2A2A with subtle border #333333) with generous padding (h-16 or h-18):
  * Left: A circular vivid orange knob (#F2762E) with an off-white power icon (SVG).
  * Center: Off-white crisp text label 'Get Started' (Outfit font-semibold).
  * Right: Double chevron icons '>>' in muted grey/orange indicating the slide direction.
- Strictly NO bottom navigation bar. Clean, spacious, calm, and uncluttered.
screens.title: Hearth - Onboarding

screens.prompt:
Smart home mobile app Hearth: CLIMATE DETAIL screen in DARK mode.
Viewport constraints: 390x844 mobile viewport, fits comfortably without excessive scrolling.
Colors & styling: Charcoal near-black background #1A1A1A, dark rounded cards #2A2A2A with 20-24px border radius, raised interactive controls #333333, crisp off-white text #F5F2EE, muted subtext #8C8782, single vivid orange accent #F2762E. Clean geometric sans font (Outfit). Thin rounded line icons (Material Symbols Outlined), no gradients, no emoji.

Screen composition:
1. Top bar: Round circular back button (chevron_left/arrow_back) on the left, centered title "Living room" with font-bold Outfit, round circular more options button (more_vert/more_horiz) on the right. Both buttons in #2A2A2A or #333333 circular containers.
2. Status indicator chip: Small centered pill badge with a subtle orange dot and text "Cooling" in vivid orange #F2762E (e.g. bg-[#F2762E]/15 text-[#F2762E] font-medium text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full).
3. Thermostat dial section:
   - A large, beautifully crafted circular thermostat dial SVG/graphic: dark ring track (#2A2A2A/#333333) with a vivid orange #F2762E arc covering approximately 60%, with a circular knob at the active endpoint.
   - Dial center: subtle "TARGET" uppercase caption in #8C8782, a huge prominent "22°" temperature reading in bold #F5F2EE, and below it "Inside 24°" in #8C8782 with small thermometer icon.
   - Stepper controls on either side of the dial: a circular raised button with minus icon (-) on the left, and a circular raised button with plus icon (+) on the right, both in #2A2A2A/#333333 with off-white icons.
4. Mode selector: Horizontal row of pill chips:
   - "Cool" active pill: filled vivid orange #F2762E with dark or white text and snowflake icon.
   - "Heat" inactive pill: #2A2A2A bg, #8C8782 text, subtle border or raised style.
   - "Dry" inactive pill: #2A2A2A bg, #8C8782 text.
   - "Fan" inactive pill: #2A2A2A bg, #8C8782 text.
5. Fan speed card:
   - Card container (#2A2A2A, rounded-[22px], p-4): Header with fan icon and "Fan speed", label showing "Auto" or "Level 2". A clean 3-step segmented or dot selector showing 3 discrete speed dots/segments (1, 2, 3 / Low, Mid, High) with active step in #F2762E.
6. Schedule card:
   - Card container (#2A2A2A, rounded-[22px], p-4): Clock/schedule icon, title "Schedule", subtext "Comfort · 6:00 PM – 11:00 PM", and an active iOS-style toggle switch in ON position (orange #F2762E background with white thumb).
7. Bottom Action:
   - Full-width vivid orange pill button: background #F2762E, text #F5F2EE or #1A1A1A bold, label "Apply", height 52px, rounded-full.
8. CRITICAL: NO bottom navigation bar on this detail screen. Clean bottom padding.
screens.title: Hearth - Climate Detail

outputComponents.text:
I have designed the **Climate Detail** screen for **Hearth** in Dark Mode, matching the established design tokens and 390×844 mobile viewport constraints:

### Key Design Highlights
- **Palette & Atmosphere:** Set against charcoal near-black (`#1A1A1A`) with soft-rounded `#2A2A2A` cards, raised controls (`#333333`), crisp off-white text (`#F5F2EE`), and muted grey subtext (`#8C8782`).
- **Header & Navigation:** Includes circular back and more-action buttons framing the centered "Living room" title, paired with the active "Cooling" status badge.
- **Thermostat Dial:** Features a prominent circular dial with a vivid orange (`#F2762E`) arc tracking 60% of the gauge, complete with an end knob indicator, large "22°" target temperature, "Inside 24°" ambient readout, and flanked circular `–` and `+` adjust buttons.
- **HVAC Modes:** A horizontal row of mode pills highlighting the active **Cool** state in vivid orange alongside Heat, Dry, and Fan options.

     - Thursday ("Thu") is highlighted with the vivid orange #F2762E bar (height e.g. 85%).
     - All other days (Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun) are muted grey (#3E3E3E or #4A4A4A).

- Floating rounded pill navbar docked near bottom (pill-shaped rounded-full, max-w-xs mx-auto mb-4 bg-[#2A2A2A] border border-white/5 shadow-2xl px-5 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between).
